findings.evidence: naming-conventions Set table: `∉` → `notMem`. It is the only `_of_not_mem` name under `TauCeti/Geometry/Toric` (grep `_of_not_mem\b`), while the repo uses e.g. `erase_eq_self_of_notMem` (Combinatorics/Young/Corner.lean:159), `exists_isOpen_inter_eq_of_notMem_closure` (Topology/DiscreteSeparation.lean:32); its own proof calls `eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem` (line 123).
findings.issue: `preimage_subfanAnalyticMap_analyticBoundaryComponent_of_not_mem` spells `∉` as `not_mem`; the convention (and the rest of the repo) is `notMem`.

findings.evidence: `mathlib/Mathlib/Data/Set/Image.lean:694: theorem image_preimage_eq_inter_range {f : α → β} {t : Set β} : f '' f ⁻¹' t = t ∩ range f`, used verbatim at Naturality.lean:141; `range_subfanAnalyticMap` (Analytic/Fan/Subfan/Basic.lean:195) shows the range is only the union of the subfan's charts.
findings.fix: Rename to `image_subfanAnalyticMap_analyticBoundaryComponent_eq_inter_range`, following Mathlib's `Set.image_preimage_eq` vs `Set.image_preimage_eq_inter_range` split.
findings.issue: `image_subfanAnalyticMap_analyticBoundaryComponent` concludes `… = component ∩ range (subfanAnalyticMap)`, not the component itself, yet carries the same name shape as `image_analyticMap_analyticBoundaryComponent` (line 73) whose RHS *is* the component. The subfan map is not surjective in general, so the name understates the hypothesis-free conclusion.

findings.evidence: Same file: `toCone_ofToricRay` (line 72), `toCone_ofToricRay_le` (line 77), `toCone_ne_bot` (line 93), `toPointedCone_toToricRay` (line 87) all put the projection first, as does Mathlib's outermost-first rule for `(f x).proj = …` lemmas.
findings.fix: Rename to `toCone_subfanRayEmbedding` and `toCone_rayEquiv`, matching the in-file precedent.
findings.issue: `subfanRayEmbedding_toCone` (line 177) and `rayEquiv_toCone` (line 218) name the outer projection last, the reverse of every other `toCone` lemma in this file, hurting name-based discoverability of these simp lemmas.

summary: Names mostly follow the existing orbit/cone-equivalence precedent, but one lemma uses the obsolete `not_mem` spelling, one `image_` lemma hides an `∩ range` conclusion behind a name parallel to the genuinely surjective case, and two new projection lemmas invert the `toCone_*` order used by their neighbours in the same file.
